title: United in the Face of Tragedy
description:
During the days of national mourning in Poland, we stand together in grief and reflection following the tragic events in Kraków. We honor the memory of those who lost their lives and extend our deepest condolences to their families and loved ones.

Our thoughts are also with everyone affected by this tragedy. We wish those injured a full recovery and their families strength during these difficult times. May this period serve as a reminder of the importance of solidarity, mutual support, and remembrance of those who are no longer with us.

The MeshCore Poland community stands with you.
